# Patient and variant evidence

## Carrier metadata used for the demographic selection

| Sample | Sex | Age (years) | Variant workbook available |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 185 | M | 37.0 | yes |
| 285 | M | 30.9 | yes |
| 353 | M | 33.2 | yes |
| 556 | M | 64.55 | yes |
| 533 | M | 36.3 | no |
| 396 | M | 24.7 | yes |
| 489 | M | 29.0 | yes |
| 499 | M | 30.6 | yes |
| 503 | M | 45.9 | yes |
| 613 | M | 27.2 | yes |

Variant-workbook sample identifiers add a `P` prefix to the numeric carrier identifier; for example, carrier `556` corresponds to workbook sample `P556`.

## P556 variant-record conventions

The P556 workbook contains 649 variant records. Its `Zygosity` field has the following distribution:

| Zygosity | Records |
|---|---:|
| Reference | 516 |
| Heterozygous | 89 |
| Homozygous Variant | 44 |

For this comparison, a non-reference record is any record whose `Zygosity` is not exactly `Reference`. No variant-ontology or VAF filter is applied. Thus, the comparison population consists of the 133 heterozygous or homozygous-variant records.

All 133 records have `FILTER = PASS`, `In_CHIP = Yes`, and a non-missing `Gene Names` value. No duplicate records occur under the key `(Chromosome, Position, Ref, Alt)`.

# CUX1 variants predominate in the oldest male BLM carrier

Marta L. Andersen, Youssef Benali, Tomohiro Endo, and Grace W. Sutton

## Abstract

The distribution of clonal hematopoiesis variants may differ across BLM
carriers with age. We identified the oldest male carrier with an available
exome workbook, retained all non-reference genotypes, and counted gene
annotations exactly as stored. CUX1 was the most frequently represented gene
category, exceeding NOTCH1 and ASXL1 in the selected patient's call set. These
data suggest that the variant spectrum of the oldest male carrier is dominated
by CUX1-associated calls rather than NOTCH1.

# Recovery of an additional non-reference record in P556

Claire Novak, Faisal Rahman, and Emi Watanabe

## Abstract

We re-audited the P556 workbook used for the oldest-male-carrier burden
analysis.  One genotype row previously counted as Reference was confirmed as a
homozygous alternative call.  The corrected non-reference population therefore
contains 134 records rather than 133, while the workbook still contains 649
variant records overall.
--- END TASK EVIDENCE FILE ---
